**Finding submitted — MFN: deviation.**

- **Responsive locations:** § 7.2 (p0027) imposes an unlimited MFN on us (best terms given to any other technology supplier); § 12.3 (p0050) conversely records that we made no most-favoured-customer commitment. No other MFN, benchmarking, or right-to-match mechanic exists in the document, and nothing cross-references Section 7.2.
- **Classification:** The obligation runs against Customer and is open-ended (no defined product, no 12-month limit, no like-for-like carve-outs), so it fails fallback and is walk-away territory.
- **Cure (preferred, validated ok:true):** minimal in-place edit changing "shall offer" to "has no obligation to offer" in § 7.2, which removes the burden, resolves the conflict with § 12.3, and leaves any Vendor-granted MFN in our favour untouched.
